verdict.rationale: The x402 Bazaar is a public, cross-merchant catalog of more than 23,000 payable resources. Docs say agents can search it by intent, with network, asset, scheme and price filters, through APIs, an OpenAPI client, the TypeScript SDK or the Bazaar MCP server, and that no CDP API key is needed. A runtime probe confirmed a keyless GET returned real listings, and sellers are indexed automatically with no registration or partnership. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of the intent-search endpoint itself (the probe hit the listing endpoint), and evidence covering merchant product catalogs beyond payable API services; search is also capped at 20 results.
